text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired (pagerduty#PROD-INF-1) for service 'prod-inference' — HIGH latency spike observed in eu-west-1. Trigger: 95th pct latency > 800ms for 5m. Auto-escalation enabled.

sara: i'm on call, grabbing context. can someone post recent deploys?

kevin: no deploys in the last hour from CI. i saw a small autoscaler churn earlier but that was ~35m ago.

miguel: adding logs + quick check. tailing inference-api logs now.

miguel: ```
2026-02-21T14:18:32Z ERROR inference/runtime.go:312 request failed: rpc timeout
2026-02-21T14:18:33Z WARN queue/worker.go:58 queue depth=237 in eu-west-1
2026-02-21T14:19:05Z INFO serving/actor.go:420 started instance xg-rt-12 (GPU)
```

sara: thanks. looks like a queue backlog + some timeouts. can we confirm if fallback routing to model-compact happened? that would explain increased cpu use.

kevin: checking routing logs.

kevin: routing shows spike: 14:17-14:21 many requests routed to model-4-quant (compatible but slower at long context). fallback count +320.

sara: customer impact? any 5xx or auth errors?

miguel: 5xx rate stable. primary impact is latency and higher token cost. one customer (acct: team-zepto) reported UI slowdown via support ticket. linking pd alert to ticket 7892.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident assigned to sara (ack at 1769998900). Escalation policy: oncall-sre -> eng-runtime. Next escalation in 8m if not resolved.

aaron: @sara if you want help, i can take a 1hr handoff — i'm available to lead mitigation while you handle comms.

sara: thanks @aaron — please take lead. i'll update customer comms thread and post status. handing ownership now.

sara: handoff note: current mitigation = increase per-instance concurrency cap from 8 -> 12 in eu-west-1, enable extra burst pool (temp), and investigate why fallback routes spiked.

aaron: applying concurrency change now. patching autoscaler policy to allow burstPools=2.

aaron: ```bash
# ramp concurrency on inference-service eu-west-1
redwoodctl patch svc prod-inference --region eu-west-1 --set concurrency=12
redwoodctl scale pool burst-eu-west --replicas 2
```

aaron: change applied. monitoring metrics.

kevin: seeing queue depth drop: 237 -> 40 in 90s. p95 down from ~920ms -> 260ms. looks promising.

aaron: great. i'll keep an eye for 10m, then we can rollback burstPool if stable. please keep PD status updated.

sara: updated PD incident summary and support ticket. marking 'acknowledged' and 'in progress'. will post a short incident note after 30m window. :thumbsup:

miguel: follow-up action: create alert to detect abnormal fallback rate (>50/min) and add runbook step to check routing health. filing a ticket: INF-4573.

aaron: thanks. leaving the thread to @sara for comms. i'm staying on standby for handoff if needed.

sara: last ping before I close eyes for 30m break — all stable. will reopen if PD escalates.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: auto-escalation timer paused (acknowledged by sara).
